title: Tee back
note: Kept: ropes that run straight off the JETS edges, chunky float bars with red end zones, a constant lane line with a T. Rejected: the blocky letterforms, the pennant bunting and the fighter-like jet. (Earlier round; superseded by the picked lockup and jet.)

title: Hoodie front
note: Kept: one hero tail code over a rule and a serial line, and a swept-fin A whose leading edge lines up with the red flash. Rejected: the run-on band text and the oversized sleeve type. (Earlier round; superseded by the picked lockup and jet.)

title: Crewneck
note: Kept: a moderate arch in a squared extra-condensed face, wrapping a solid red jet over a horizon line. Rejected: stencil cuts on every letter and the faked letter widths. (Earlier round; superseded by the picked lockup and jet.)

title: Hip lockups (picked: right)
note: The team picked the right-hand lockup for the front of the tee, crewneck and hoodie: a red jet with a chevron stripe over stencil JETS and a spaced 26-27. Redrawn as clean vector; the jet span sits just inside the JETS width.

title: Stencil lettering
note: Kept: only vertical and horizontal bridges, an E split from its stem, a T gap under the bar, and a pointed A split by a slit. Rejected: uneven widths and tiny 3% bridges. (Earlier round; superseded by the picked lockup and jet.)

title: Jet mark (picked: right)
note: The team picked the right-hand jet for the back: a white twin-tail fighter with a red chevron across the wings and keyline panel cuts. Redrawn symmetric on a coordinate grid, with a keyline of bare garment between the red and the main ink.
